hero.heading: Windshield Replacement in Boulder City, NV
hero.note: Chip or small crack? That is a different, smaller job. See windshield chip repair.
hero.intro: Every windshield we replace starts with a part ordered to your vehicle's VIN, so the curve, the tint band along the top edge and the sensor mounts all match what the manufacturer built. Chip repair we do here, in our own shop. Full replacements we subcontract to a glass specialist, and we handle everything around it: the glass is ordered to your VIN, the work is booked, and we help you file the insurance claim. One call, one point of contact. We serve Boulder City, Henderson and Las Vegas drivers alike. One thing to know before you call: we do not keep windshields in stock. Your glass is ordered in for your specific vehicle, so the appointment is booked for after it arrives, not for the day you ring us. That is usually within a week.
